text: The B.S. in Computer Science (2023-2024 Catalog) requires 124 hours for graduation, which must include 51 hours as Upper Division. The degree plan totals 73 lower-division hours and 51 upper-division hours, and is organized into Major Preparatory Requirements, Major Core Requirements, Remaining Core Curriculum, and Electives (10 hours). Students must have a minimum cumulative 2.0 GPA in all UTD coursework and a cumulative 2.0 GPA in all Major requirements to graduate. Students must also complete 45 hours in residence and complete 24 of the last 30 hours at UTD. No off-campus courses are allowed in the last semester.

text: Notes for the B.S. in Computer Science (2023-2024 Catalog) degree plan: (1) must earn a C or better to receive credit; (2) must earn a C- or better to receive credit; (3) must earn a D- or better to receive credit; (4) incoming freshmen (FTIC) must enroll and complete requirements of UNIV 1010 and the corresponding school-related freshmen seminar course; (5) all students, including transfer students, who complete their core curriculum at UT Dallas must take UNIV 2020; and (6) most lower division (LD) coursework can be taken at a community college and transferred (see the online transfer plan for course equivalents). Courses marked with * (Major Preparatory Requirements and Major Core Requirements) are included in the Major GPA. Transfer students may be required to complete an additional upper level (3000 or 4000) CS/SE course substitution.
